EXCUSE_REQUEST.meaning: Develop a new plan to get out of, skip, or decline an obligation, or propose another excuse or approach to a previous decline plan.
examples: Get me out of Tuesday's training
Give me another excuse for that session
EXCUSE_REQUEST.exclusions: Editing, rewriting, translating or changing the style of supplied text; asking questions about a plan; holding or rejecting a candidate in human review.

CHAT.meaning: Ordinary conversation, answering questions, applying a writing skill, editing or translating source text, discussing a plan, or responding to an existing review without requesting a new plan.
examples: Rewrite this email: I cannot attend the training
Turn that up to eleven
Which excuses did I use before?
Hold, no action
CHAT.exclusions: A clear request to develop a new decline plan, including another excuse for a previous target.

event.instructions: If `userMessage` asks for a new plan to avoid an obligation, which single record in `calendar` is the intended target? Resolve references using `conversation`. Match the title, organizer and supplied human-readable date labels. Select an exact event ID only when the evidence identifies one target. Do not choose an unrelated event or a previously declined record just because it shares the organizer. If multiple obligations are requested, or multiple records fit equally, choose AMBIGUOUS. If no record matches, choose NO_MATCH. For editing or ordinary chat, choose NO_MATCH.

ways-of-working-2026.title: Agile Ways of Working Alignment Workshop

criteria.NO_MATCH: No matching target, or the user is not requesting a decline plan.
criteria.AMBIGUOUS: More than one possible target, insufficient evidence to choose one, or multiple targets requested.
